---

## Description
A clear and concise description of what the feature does and why it's needed.

## Problem It Solves
Explain the problem this feature would solve. Is it related to a specific use case or user need?

## Use Case
Describe how you would use this feature. Provide an example scenario if possible.

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you think this feature should work. What would the user experience be?

## Alternative Solutions
Have you considered any alternative solutions or features?

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or references here.

## Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing issues to avoid duplicates
- [ ] This feature is not already implemented
- [ ] I can explain the benefits of this feature
- [ ] This aligns with the project's goals
